frozen_candidate_root_contribution: The obtaining of a state of affairs: an entity standing actualized in a determinate condition, identity, or position — 'being-so' as realized fact (or, negated/commanded, as fact denied or brought to obtain) — rather than any agentive action.

internal_discovery.candidate_root_contribution: The obtaining of a state of affairs: an entity standing actualized in a determinate condition, identity, or position — 'being-so' as realized fact (or, negated/commanded, as fact denied or brought to obtain) — rather than any agentive action.
internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Across all 1390 occurrences, kwn never names an action someone performs on something; it always asserts that a situation holds (or comes to hold, or fails to hold). The perfect asserts an established state (33:1 'inna Allāha kāna ʿalīman ḥakīman'; 21:30 'kānatā ratqan'); the imperfect asserts a state coming to obtain (101:4 'yawma yakūnu al-nāsu ka-l-farāsh'); the imperative commands a state into obtaining (16:40, 2:117 'kun fa-yakūn'; 2:65 'kūnū qiradatan'); the negation denies that being obtained at all (19:67 'wa-lam yaku shayʾan' — 'he was not a thing', a fully existential use); the deontic 'mā kāna li-X an…' (19:35, 3:79) denies that a state lies within X's proper compass of being. The nouns carry the same residue into the 'where' dimension: makān is the locus in which something's being is instantiated — including substitutive and status uses that outrun bare geometry (12:78 'take one of us in his makān', 28:82 'those who yesterday coveted his makān') — and makānat is one's standing, the position in which one is (39:39/6:135 'act according to your makānat', 36:67 'We would have transformed them ʿalā makānatihim'). Subtract the maf ʿal place-pattern and the abstract-feminine pattern, and the residue 'position-of-being' remains non-empty in every nominal occurrence.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: FORM: perfect kāna = the state obtains as established fact (with divine subjects, established without inception — 33:1, 4:1); imperfect yakūn = the state comes to/will obtain; apocopated yaku/taku = same under jussive negation; imperative kun/kūnū = command that the state obtain; maf'al noun makān = 'place-of' + root 'being' = locus of instantiated being; abstract makānat = station/standing. CONSTRUCTION: kāna + imperfect verb = habitual past frame (10:12 'mā kānū yaʿmalūn') — habituality belongs to the construction, not the root; 'mā kāna li-X an' = deontic exclusion, where the deontic force is the li- construction over the root's 'obtaining within one's scope'; 'kun fa-yakūn' = inception supplied by imperative + qadā-amr context. CONTEXT supplies the specific predicate, place, or era. After subtracting all three layers, the constant residue — a situation's actualized obtaining — is present in every occurrence.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: The nominal cluster makān/makānat (30 N + 2 LOC): 'place' looks semantically remote from copular 'be', and a hostile reading treats makān as an unrelated concrete-place lexeme. It survives because the packet's own uses exceed bare geometry: 12:78 'khudh aḥadanā makānahu' (occupy his position/stead), 28:82 'tamannaw makānahu' (coveted his standing), 39:39 and 6:135 'iʿmalū ʿalā makānatikum' (act from the standing you are in), 36:67 'la-masakhnāhum ʿalā makānatihim' (transformed where/as they stand) — all of which read as 'the position in which one's being is instantiated', exactly the maf'al of the verbal residue. A secondary hard case, divine-attribute kāna (33:1 'kāna ʿalīman ḥakīman'), threatens an inceptive reading of the root ('came to be') but not the preferred residue, since inception was assigned to the imperative/context layer, not the root.
internal_discovery.competing_hypothesis: kwn is a fully grammaticalized tense-carrying copula/auxiliary with no semantic residue of its own (pure 'was/were' machinery). Rejected on internal evidence: (1) existential uses where kwn is the sole predicate — 19:9/19:67 'wa-lam taku/yaku shayʾan' ('you/he was not a thing'), 76:1, 98:1 — assert or deny being itself, which a contentless auxiliary cannot do; (2) the creation formula 'kun fa-yakūn' (16:40, 2:117, 3:47, 3:59, 36:82) makes kwn the very event of coming-to-obtain under divine command; (3) a semantically empty auxiliary could not yield the derived nouns makān/makānat with their position-of-being uses (12:78, 28:82, 39:39).
internal_discovery.distinctiveness_note: vs j-ʿ-l (jaʿala): jʿl is agent-side rendering-into-a-state; kwn is the state's own obtaining — the packet repeatedly pairs them across one clause boundary (agent act → li-yakūna result, e.g. 28:10, 26:194 'li-takūna mina l-mundhirīn'). vs w-j-d: finding/encountering what obtains, from a perceiver's side, not the obtaining itself. vs the ṣāra/aṣbaḥa class of time-inflected state-entry verbs: kwn is unmarked for time-of-day or transition framing. vs s-k-n (dwelling/rest) for the nominal side: makān is the sheer locus of standing-being (7:143 'in istaqarra makānahu'), not a dwelling. Falsifiable: the claim dies if any occurrence used kwn for an agentive act or motion with no state obtaining, or makān where no position-of-being reading is possible; none of the 1390 does.
internal_discovery.rationale: Full coverage was achieved mechanically: every one of the 1390 packet occurrences was resolved to its exact token via word_ref indexing against the Tanzil verse text, yielding 84 verbal, 6 nominal, and 1 locative surface types, each assigned to a construction cluster and each cluster reconciled to the proposed residue; resistant refs were then read individually. Seven refs initially failed token alignment (25:1, 33:1, 4:1, 60:1, 76:1, 8:1, 98:1) but all proved to be sura-initial verses where Tanzil includes the 4-token basmala that QAC indexing omits; shifting by 4 lands each on a genuine kwn token, so they are data-alignment artifacts, not semantic anomalies. The hardest semantic cases — divine-attribute kāna (no inception), existential lam yaku shayʾan, deontic mā kāna li-, and the makān/makānat nominals — all reconcile once form/construction layers are subtracted, with the nominal position-of-being uses (12:78, 28:82, 39:39) actively confirming rather than merely tolerating the residue. No occurrence resisted; universal presence holds across the entire confirmed set, and the residue is non-empty, distinctive against jʿl/wjd/skn, and falsifiable.

adversarial_verification.notes: Full coverage verified: 1390 occ = 1358 V + 30 N + 2 LOC; every occurrence accounted for. VERBAL CORE (1358): homogeneous kAna/yakUn/kun/takUn/akUn/nakUn = copula/existential/aspectual-auxiliary/creative-imperative 'be'. Robustly supports the proposed contribution — predicated being-so as realized fact (kAna Allahu ghafUran), negated fact (mA kuntum), aspectual held-state (kAnU yaSna'Un), and commanded fact-brought-to-obtain (kun fayakUn, explicitly covered). No Form-X istakAna/submission verbs in packet, so no agentive counterexamples there. Distinctiveness of the verbal being-so residue holds vs nearest existence-root wjd (find/exist) and vs pure event verbs. FAILING CLUSTER: the maf'al nominal/locative set. Pure spatial locus (min kulli makAn; makAnan sharqiyyan/qaSiyyan/'aliyyan/suwan/Dayyiqan; min makAnin ba'Id/qarIb; fI makAnin saHIq; makAna l-bayt; istaqarra makAnahu; makAnakum) and substitution 'instead of' (zawjin makAna zawjin; AyatanmakAna Ayatin; baddalnA makAna s-sayyi'ati; khudh aHadanA makAnahu; tamannaw makAnahu) denote a spatial place or a substitution relation, NOT 'the obtaining of a state of affairs / an entity standing actualized in a condition'. The proposed gloss is reachable here only via derivational etymology (maf'al = place-of-being) and the loosest reading of the 'position' clause — both barred by the method (residue must be demonstrable in the occurrence, not imported). Moreover the 'place' residue is NOT distinctive to kwn (overlaps maqAm from qwm, mawDi'), unlike the verbal being-so residue. RECONCILABLE (not counted as failures): makAnat 'standing/capacity' (i'malU 'alA makAnatikum: 11:93,11:121,39:39,6:135,36:67) and 'sharrun makAnan' (12:77,19:75,25:34,5:60) — these fit the explicit 'position/standing' clause. CONCLUSION: robust verbal unity, but a well-defined nominal place/substitution subset does not demonstrably carry the specific proposed contribution; under non-negotiable unity, verdict != SUPPORTED -> PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED. A stricter, purely-predicative reading of the gloss would push to REFUTED; the abundant, homogeneous verbal core prevents full refutation.

كَانُوا۟ in كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ is the perfect auxiliary over the imperfect main verb يَعْمَلُونَ. The agentive 'doing' is carried by يَعْمَلُونَ, not by kwn; كانوا contributes only the assertion that the state of affairs — their being-doers — obtained as an established/habitual realized fact. Subtracting the auxiliary+imperfect construction, the frozen 'being-so as realized fact' residue is demonstrably present.
